title: Mukhyamantri Bal Hridaya Upchar Yojana
department: Department of Public Health & Family Welfare
eligibility: Meets income & category guidelines specified by department.
benefits: Direct financial/social assistance under Mukhyamantri Bal Hridaya Upchar Yojana.
State welfare delivery as per MP Govt rules.
application_process: Step 1: Apply online via MPOnline Kiosk or Lok Sewa Kendra.
Step 2: Submit physical application along with required documents.
Step 3: Verification by designated Departmental Authority.
important_sections_or_clauses: Madhya Pradesh Lok Sewaon Ke Pradan Ki Guarantee Adhiniyam, 2010
